name: Max Cekot Kitchen

menus.name: Set menu
menus.note: Thursday to Saturday dinner; juice pairing €105; a vegetarian version is offered

menus.name: Chef's Table set menu
menus.note: Four seats facing the kitchen; no vegetarian, gluten-free or lactose-free changes

bookingOpens: Online on the restaurant's website, choosing a table or the Chef's Table; the dinner is paid in advance when booking.
cancellation: Cancel by email to info@maxcekot.com up to five business days before the dinner for a full refund; after that the prepayment is not refunded.
children: Children are welcome if they are used to restaurant etiquette and have the tasting menu.
